text:
maria: Quick proposal — add a routing header for soft-priority so we can prefer cheaper model variants without changing client routing logic. header name: `x-rw-route-score` (0-100). idea: gateway picks route with highest score that meets policy. signing to prevent spoofing (HMAC). thoughts?

sam: I like the score approach. question: precedence vs existing tenant headers — do we override tenant pinning? we should ensure tenant pin wins when present.

jin: Fallback rules: if `x-rw-route-score` missing, fallback to UA heuristics (mobile gets lower-cost models) and then to default route. keep it simple for now. :+1:

security-team: HMAC signing is a must if clients can set the header. proposal: require header to be signed by the auth service using per-tenant key; gateway verifies with cached public key. reject unsigned or invalid signatures. also rate-limit header-verified route overrides to mitigate abuse.

maria: Agreed. rough config sketch for Envoy route matcher:

```
- match:
    prefix: "/v1/generate"
    headers:
      - name: "x-rw-route-score"
        present_match: true
  route: "route_with_score"
```

Then verification filter runs before route selection to validate signature and attach metadata `rw.route.score`.

sam: Implementation note: don't let raw header control critical quotas (like reserved capacity). only use for model variant selection where we can gracefully fall back. also log both "requested_score" and "applied_score" for telemetry.

infra-bot: deploy-preview available: https://deploys.internal/preview/route-score-2026-07-14 (staging only) :rocket:

dave: Telemetry we need: counter `route_score_applied{route,tenant}` histogram of latency delta when score-based routing used, and alert if error-rate increases >0.5% in canary. sampling: 10% full traces, 1% production sampling otherwise.

jin: Minor UX: console should show "score source" (client header / ua heuristic / default) and a link to example requests so support can reproduce. also add a flag `enable_score_overrides` per-tenant.

security-team: Also consider replay protection for signed header — include nonce/timestamp in signature and reject >60s old. store minimal audit event for signed overrides.

maria: Plan: 1) implement verifier filter + metadata attachment (edge) 2) add route selection logic that prefers signed score but respects tenant pinning 3) staging deploy + telemetry dashboards (dave) 4) 10% canary (sam) 5) roll to 100% if metrics ok. I'll open a PR and link.

sam: please add a test matrix in the PR: unsigned header, expired signature, tenant-pinned, missing header, user-agent fallback.

maria: will do. ping me if you want to pair on the Envoy filter. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
